categories.main_business_segments: Kailong High Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the atmospheric pollution control industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of internal combustion engine exhaust after-treatment systems. Its main product lines include selective catalytic reduction (SCR) systems, particulate capture systems (DPF), new energy CNG engine exhaust after-treatment systems, automotive inspection and testing, industrial VOCs waste gas treatment, precision manufacturing, and new energy thermal management systems. The company also develops silicon carbide new materials and related catalytic products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as selective catalytic reduction, diesel particulate filters, catalytic oxidation, and silicon carbide materials with high thermal conductivity and strength. Manufacturing methods include automated production lines with PLC control, microwave drying, laser drilling, and sintering processes. The company also develops electronic control units, injection systems, and thermal management components like PTC heaters and heat exchangers, supported by extensive R&D facilities and engine test benches.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kailong serves major engine manufacturers and vehicle OEMs, including commercial vehicle producers and non-road machinery manufacturers. Key customers include well-known domestic and international companies such as Weichai Power, Sany Group, Deutz, Yuchai Power, FAW Jiefang, Dongfeng Motor, China National Heavy Duty Truck Group, Foton Motor, and SAIC Maxus. The company’s products are widely used in road vehicles, non-road mobile machinery, ships, agricultural machinery, construction machinery, and power generation sets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong domestic market presence across regions such as East China, Central China, Southwest China, South China, and Northeast China. It is also expanding its international footprint with strategic cooperation agreements and project collaborations in Russia, Turkey, Iran, Italy, Saudi Arabia, and Sweden. The company pursues a 'domestic + international' strategy to broaden overseas market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kailong operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of engine exhaust after-treatment systems and related components. It supplies core parts such as catalyst carriers, injection pumps, and urea dosing systems to engine and vehicle manufacturers. The company also provides testing and inspection services, positioning itself as a key technology and component supplier within the automotive and industrial pollution control supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation with a focus on meeting increasingly stringent emission standards (China VI and upcoming China VII). R&D priorities include development of advanced SCR and DPF systems, dual-injection urea systems, methanol and ammonia fuel engine after-treatment, and new energy vehicle thermal management products such as PTC heaters and front-end cooling modules. It invests in silicon carbide new materials and collaborates with universities and research institutes to enhance product performance and expand into new markets like hydrogen fuel cell components.
categories.revenue_model: Kailong generates revenue primarily through direct sales of its proprietary branded products and OEM manufacturing contracts. The company operates on a make-to-order basis with annual framework agreements and zero-inventory management for key customers. Revenue streams include product sales of exhaust after-treatment systems, catalytic materials, thermal management components, and testing services. The company also receives government subsidies and occasional investment income, but product sales dominate its revenue model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kailong is a leading domestic player in the engine exhaust after-treatment and pollution control industry in China, recognized for its strong R&D capabilities and comprehensive product portfolio. It holds a significant market share in commercial vehicle emission control systems and is a key contributor to national emission standards development. Competitors include other specialized automotive pollution control equipment manufacturers and catalyst producers, but Kailong’s integration of silicon carbide materials and new energy thermal management systems provides competitive differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Kailong achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.04 billion, representing a 67.91% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 9.36 million. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.7 billion, growing 9.75% from the previous year. Kailong has shown a strong recovery and growth trajectory driven by market demand rebound, product expansion, and operational improvements. It maintains a stable capital structure with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kailong emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced pollution control solutions that comply with stringent emission regulations, offering effective reduction of NOx and particulate matter emissions. Its products feature high thermal resistance, durability, and efficiency, supported by proprietary silicon carbide materials and integrated system designs. The company provides one-stop comprehensive services including R&D, manufacturing, and testing, ensuring customized solutions and reliable performance for commercial vehicles, non-road machinery, and industrial applications. Its strong innovation capability and strategic partnerships enhance its competitive edge.
